title: Viva Engage: handle GDPR deletion requests in the Engage admin center
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's documentation supports the deletion options, administrator roles and automation calls, and the roadmap facts match the record. It appropriately reports the conflicting status and role guidance. Two checklist actions have no corresponding controls-table row, a minor completeness issue.

claims.quote: User lifecycle management should generally be performed through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center or Microsoft Entra. API-based user deletions may lead to unrecoverable data loss and are therefore not recommended.
